name: heychengc/vibe-knowledge-film
description: A skill for making Douyin viral Vibe knowledge short films, guiding topic, script, visuals, and rendering for short knowledge videos in a consistent style.
install: Place the directory in the agent skills directory (for example ~/.claude/skills/vibe-knowledge-film), then pip install -r requirements.txt, python -m playwright install, and python engine/get_fonts.py (requires local Google Chrome and ffmpeg)
